title: MY VOICE MATTERS
note: Not released. Song: My Voice Matters, and I Use It with Confidence (3:32, hip-hop with soft house shimmer, 127 BPM), Suno take f5c14352. Over 3:00: the vertical cut needs --cut3m-start. Covers: make in ChatGPT from the FREQ 001 cover, lines MY VOICE|MATTERS. Calendar: freq/CALENDAR.md.
alt_text: A gold frequency ring glows around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold, under the title MY VOICE MATTERS, NDCH FREQ 008. The picture pushes in slowly and the gold breathes brighter while one line repeats: My voice matters, and I use it with confidence.

location.name: Lincoln Memorial
location.why: Dr. King spoke from these steps in 1963 and the country heard him. Posting on Martin Luther King Jr. Day.
